   454	function buildConfigRoutes(
   455	  configPath: string,

   463	    { method: 'GET', path: '/api/server-info', noBody: true,
   464	      handler: async () => {

   466	        const disk = captureWorkspaceVersions();
   467	        const stale =
   468	          boot.mcpServer !== disk.mcpServer ||
   469	          boot.personas !== disk.personas ||
   470	          boot.orchestrator !== disk.orchestrator;
   471	        return { stale, bootVersions: boot, diskVersions: disk };
   472	      } },
   473	    // GET /api/config
   474	    { method: 'GET', path: '/api/config', noBody: true,

   476	  ];

   506	    // POST /api/orchestrator/dismiss/:id — 204 No Content
